correctness.rationale: A block of a marked/unmarked split has sign (-1)^a iff its total size is even. The exponential formula gives exp(cosh(y-x)-1+sinh(x+y)), with the exact Poisson shift formula after expansion in unmarked block sizes. For all even k>=2, each shifted Poisson kth moment is strictly positive; k=0 gives Bell(n)>0. The even-cardinality support yields complementary Walsh equality, covering every character at odd n. At n=2 rank and nullity follow by explicit two-partition enumeration. The standalone exact checker independently enumerates partitions through n=9 and confirms the moment and recurrence identities (2024 assertions); no finite check is substituted for the proof.
